Name: More Movie Theater Snacks
Author: MyCastlesCrumbling
Description:
This mod adds new foods to the Stardew Movie Theater. Unfortunately, these new foods only show up sometimes at random times, due to how the Valley changes food every day.
New Foods
1. Blue Slushie
2. Red Slushie
3. Cola Slushie
4. Sour Kids

Now your Spouse / Date can enjoy some new concessions at the local theater!
